title: The records of F28 read in two other orders
policy: P4: a join is never undone, and a record with an id that two pairs carry is counted on its own as ambiguous. The total can therefore depend on the order the records are read in; the two pairs are never merged in any order, and every order marks the total uncertain.
derivation: F28's records: partial [100, 50], pair A [100, 60], pair B [300, 30], partial [100, 70]. F28 reads them in that order: 660, 1 identified, 1 incomplete, 1 ambiguous. Order B (hour 16, pairs first): A 160 and B 330 are two identified groups and the id is ambiguous before any partial arrives; the partials form one ambiguous group [100, 50] then [100, 70] (+20): 660, 2 identified, 1 ambiguous. Order C (hour 17): A 160; partial [100, 70] joins A (+10, incomplete, 170); B 330 makes the id ambiguous; partial [100, 50] is a new ambiguous group, 150: 650, 1 identified, 1 incomplete, 1 ambiguous. Same records, totals 660 / 660 / 650: path-dependent, as P4 accepts, and never exact. In every order A and B stay separate (3 groups, 3 calls per order).
